repairs.text: Hauria pogut passar el dia mirant els rails i saludant la gent de les parades.
repairs.pronunciation: Rails means the two metal railway tracks. Use a clear Central Catalan pronunciation with separate ra-ÍLS, stress on I, with a final ordinary L followed by S; never a palatal LL as in ralls. This pronunciation guide is instruction only, never spoken. Keep the complete sentence fluent.
